meta.title: Price Caps and Tick Size: not available on plans below Growth
gaps: Sign in to and verify the subscription plan of both a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant.
Assert that Price Caps and Tick Size are absent or refused specifically because the tenant is below Growth.
Configure or use Tick Size, including verifying the minimum decrement works on the Growth tenant.

plan.title: Price Caps and Tick Size Plan Gating

args.need: sign in to a below-Growth tenant and a Growth tenant, compare Price Caps and Tick Size availability using the same buyer flow, and leave the browser on the Growth tenant's published RFQ or auction Participants list

steps.note: The catalog cannot select arbitrary tenants, inspect their subscription plans, or configure Tick Size; the tester must perform the plan comparison and leave the Growth tenant ready.
Verify that the supported Growth-tenant Price Cap flow can be used on the published event.
Assert that the Price Cap entered on the Growth tenant was saved and is readable.
